#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* For test registration */
#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_MULTITHREADING
#define ZTEST_DMEM K_APP_DMEM(ztest_mem_partition)
#define ZTEST_BMEM K_APP_BMEM(ztest_mem_partition)
extern K_MEM_PARTITION_DEFINE(ztest_mem_partition, NULL, 0, 0);
#else
#define ZTEST_DMEM
#define ZTEST_BMEM
#endif

struct ztest_stats {
	int pass;
	int fail;
	int skip;
};

struct ztest_unit_test {
	const char *name;
	void (*test)(void *data);
	void (*setup)(void *data);
	void (*teardown)(void *data);
	void *user_data;
	void *fixture;
	struct ztest_stats *stats;
};

/* Forward declaration */
struct ztest_suite_stats;

struct ztest_test_suite {
	const char *name;
	bool (*predicate)(const void *data);
	void (*setup)(void *data);
	void (*teardown)(void *data);
	void (*before)(void *data);
	void (*after)(void *data);
	void *user_data;
	void *fixture;
	struct ztest_suite_stats *stats;
};

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * This macro defines a test suite with a given name and registers it for the
 * test framework.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param predicate A function that returns true if the suite should be run.
 * @param setup A function to run before the suite.
 * @param before A function to run before each test in the suite.
 * @param after A function to run after each test in the suite.
 * @param teardown A function to run after the suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE(suite, predicate, setup, before, after, teardown)                   \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_suite_stats z_ztest_suite_stats__##suite;             \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_test_suite z_ztest_test_suite__##suite = {            \
		.name = #suite,                                                                 \
		.predicate = predicate,                                                         \
		.setup = setup,                                                                 \
		.teardown = teardown,                                                           \
		.before = before,                                                               \
		.after = after,                                                                 \
		.stats = &z_ztest_suite_stats__##suite,                                         \
	};                                                                                  \
	Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_test_suite, z_ztest_test_suite__##suite)

#define _ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_INITIALIZER(suite, test, setup_fn, teardown_fn, user, fixture)     \
	static void test_##suite##_##test(void *data);                                     \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_stats z_ztest_unit_test_stats__##suite##__##test;     \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test z_ztest_unit_test__##suite##__##test = {    \
		.name = #test,                                                                  \
		.test = test_##suite##_##test,                                                  \
		.setup = setup_fn,                                                              \
		.teardown = teardown_fn,                                                        \
		.stats = &z_ztest_unit_test_stats__##suite##__##test,                            \
		.user_data = user,                                                              \
		.fixture = fixture,                                                             \
	};                                                                                  \
	Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_unit_test, z_ztest_unit_test__##suite##__##test)

#define _ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, setup, teardown, user, fixture)        \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_INITIALIZER(suite, test, setup, teardown, user, fixture);          \
	static void test_##suite##_##test(void *data)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * This is the vanilla version of the test case macro.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test(suite, test) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case that uses user data.
 *
 * This version of the test case macro allows the user to pass a void pointer
 * to their test function.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 * @param user_data A void pointer to be passed to the test function.
 */
#define ztest_user_unit_test(suite, test, user_data) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, NULL, NULL, user_data, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * This version of the test case macro allows the user to specify setup and
 * teardown functions to be run before and after the test.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(suite, test, setup, teardown) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, setup, teardown, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with setup and teardown functions that uses user data.
 *
 * This version of the test case macro allows the user to specify setup and
 * teardown functions to be run before and after the test, and to pass a void
 * pointer to their test function.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 * @param user_data A void pointer to be passed to the test function.
 */
#define ztest_user_unit_test_setup_teardown(suite, test, setup, teardown, user_data) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, setup, teardown, user_data, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test that has a parameter.
 *
 * This is useful for tests that are very similar and only vary by a parameter.
 * The parameter is passed to the test function as a void pointer.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 * @param data The parameter to pass to the test function.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_with_data(suite, test, data) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, NULL, NULL, (void *)data, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test fixture.
 *
 * This macro defines a test fixture with a given name.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param ... The fixture data.
 */
#define ztest_register_fixture(suite, ...) \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct suite##_fixture z_ztest_fixture__##suite = {__VA_ARGS__}

/**
 * @brief Define a test that uses a fixture.
 *
 * This macro defines a test that uses a fixture.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 */
#define ztest_fixture_unit_test(suite, test) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, ztest_fixture_setup, \
					ztest_fixture_teardown, NULL, &z_ztest_fixture__##suite)

/**
 * @brief Define a test that uses a fixture and has setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * This macro defines a test that uses a fixture and has setup and teardown
 * functions.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param test The name of the test.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 */
#define ztest_fixture_unit_test_setup_teardown(suite, test, setup, teardown) \
	_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(suite, test, setup, teardown, NULL, \
					&z_ztest_fixture__##suite)

/**
 * @brief Get the fixture for the current test.
 *
 * @param type The type of the fixture.
 * @return A pointer to the fixture.
 */
#define ztest_get_fixture(type) ((type *)ztest_get_user_data())

/**
 * @brief The setup function for a test that uses a fixture.
 *
 * @param data A pointer to the user data.
 */
static inline void ztest_fixture_setup(void *data)
{
	ztest_set_user_data(data);
}

/**
 * @brief The teardown function for a test that uses a fixture.
 *
 * @param data A pointer to the user data.
 */
static inline void ztest_fixture_teardown(void *data)
{
	ARG_UNUSED(data);
	ztest_set_user_data(NULL);
}

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
